title: AgentMonoculture-Sim: a tiny sandbox for cascading failures in same-model agent swarms

original_idea.body: Minimal multi-agent sim; measure failure propagation in homogeneous vs heterogeneous swarms (arXiv:2508.05687).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: cascading failures in same-model agent swarms is a recognized systemic risk.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a multi-agent message-passing sim is more involved; intermediate engineering.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Requires building a sim plus propagation metrics; multi-workstream prototype.

novelty.reasoning: Minimal observable cascade testbed may be partly open.
